import re, json, html as htmlmod
raw = Path('/tmp/eala-tdb-matches.html').read_text(errors='replace')
rows = re.findall(r'<tr[\s\S]*?</tr>', raw)
out = []
for row in rows[1:]:  # skip header
    # rivalries + matches
    riv = re.search(r'href="(/wta/rivalries/[^"]+)"', row)
    mat = re.search(r'href="(/wta/matches/[^"]+)"', row)
    if not mat:
        continue
    # strip tags for text cells
    cells = re.findall(r'<t[dh][^>]*>([\s\S]*?)</t[dh]>', row)
    texts = []
    for c in cells:
        t = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', ' ', c)
        t = htmlmod.unescape(re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', t)).strip()
        texts.append(t)
    # typical: Opponent, Score, Result, H2H, Match Data, Date, Tournament, Category, Round, Surface
    # find opponent name from player link text
    opp_m = re.search(r'/wta/players/balldontlie_wta:\d+/[^"]+"[^>]*>([^<]+)', row)
    opp = opp_m.group(1).strip() if opp_m else (texts[0] if texts else '')
    opp = re.sub(r'#\d+$', '', opp).strip()
    # date often like Aug 6, 2026
    date = next((t for t in texts if re.search(r'\b20\d{2}\b', t) and re.search(r'[A-Za-z]{3}', t)), '')
    tourney = ''
    for t in texts:
        if t in ('Hard','Clay','Grass','W','L') or re.match(r'^R\d+|QF|SF|F|Q\d', t):
            continue
        if 'WTA' in t or t == 'Grand Slam':
            continue
        if re.search(r'\b20\d{2}\b', t) and re.search(r'[A-Za-z]{3}', t) and len(t)<20:
            continue
        if opp and opp.split()[0] in t and '#' in texts[0]:
            continue
    # better: use known column positions from earlier markdown table
    # Opponent Score Result H2H Match Data Date Tournament Category Round Surface
    if len(texts) >= 10:
        date, tourney, cat, rnd, surface = texts[5], texts[6], texts[7], texts[8], texts[9]
        score, result = texts[1], texts[2]
    else:
        score = result = cat = rnd = surface = ''
        # fallback scan
        for t in texts:
            if re.match(r'\d', t) and '-' in t:
                score = t
            if t in ('W','L'):
                result = t
    riv_url = 'https://tennis-db.com' + htmlmod.unescape(riv.group(1)) if riv else None
    mat_url = 'https://tennis-db.com' + htmlmod.unescape(mat.group(1))
    out.append({
        'opp': opp, 'score': score, 'result': result, 'date': date,
        'tournament': tourney if len(texts)>=10 else texts[6] if len(texts)>6 else '',
        'category': cat if len(texts)>=10 else '',
        'round': rnd if len(texts)>=10 else '',
        'surface': surface if len(texts)>=10 else '',
        'match': mat_url, 'h2h': riv_url,
    })

print('parsed', len(out))
for r in out[:12]:
    print(f"{r['date']:16} {r['tournament']:20} {r['round']:6} {r['opp']:25} {r['match'].split('/')[-1]}")

# unique h2h by opponent last-ish name
h2h = {}
for r in out:
    if r['h2h']:
        key = r['opp'].lower()
        h2h[key] = r['h2h']
print('unique h2h', len(h2h))
Path('/tmp/eala-tdb.json').write_text(json.dumps({'matches': out, 'h2h': h2h}, indent=2))
print('wrote /tmp/eala-tdb.json')
# print washington pegula and miami pegula
for r in out:
    if 'pegula' in r['opp'].lower():
        print('PEGULA', r['date'], r['tournament'], r['round'], r['match'])
    if 'swiatek' in r['opp'].lower():
        print('SWIATEK', r['date'], r['tournament'], r['round'], r['match'])
PY
sleep 2
# second TennisDB budget page not needed; check Canadian Open progress via search only

def find_match(opp, score, tourney_ctx):
    opp_n = norm_name(opp)
    sc = norm_score(score)
    # try full name + score

    if not cands:
        # last name
        last = opp_n.split()[-1] if opp_n else &#39;&#39;
        cands = by_opp_score.get((last, sc), [])
    if not cands:
        return None, &#39;no-score-match&#39;
    if len(cands) == 1:
        return cands[0], &#39;unique&#39;
    # disambiguate by tournament
    tk = tourney_key(tourney_ctx)
    filtered = [c for c in cands if tk and tk in tourney_key(c[&#39;tournament&#39;])]
    if len(filtered) == 1:
        return filtered[0], &#39;tourney&#39;
    if len(filtered) &gt; 1:
        # prefer unused
        unused = [c for c in filtered if c[&#39;match&#39;] not in used_match_urls]
        if len(unused) == 1:
            return unused[0], &#39;unused&#39;
        return unused[0] if unused else filtered[0], &#39;multi&#39;
    # try year in date
    unused = [c for c in cands if c[&#39;match&#39;] not in used_match_urls]
    if len(unused) == 1:
        return unused[0], &#39;unused-only&#39;
    if tk:
        # fuzzy: any cand tournament contains a word from context
        words = set(tk.split())
        fuzzy = [c for c in cands if words &amp; set(tourney_key(c[&#39;tournament&#39;]).split())]
        unusedf = [c for c in fuzzy if c[&#39;match&#39;] not in used_match_urls]
        if len(unusedf) == 1:
            return unusedf[0], &#39;fuzzy&#39;
    return (unused[0] if unused else cands[0]), &#39;fallback&#39;

# Pattern for result lines with links

result_re = re.compile(
    r&#39;^(\s*.*?\b(?:d\.|l\.)\s+)(?:\[([^\]]+)\]\([^)]+\)|([A-Za-zÀ-ž][A-Za-zÀ-ž\s\-\&#39;]+?))(\s+)(\d[\d\s,\-\(\)ret\.w/o]*)(\s*\|\s*)(\[wtatennis\.com\]\([^)]+\))(.*)$&#39;
)
# also lines that are only Round | [wtatennis.com] without d./l. - skip those for match matching unless we have round context
# H2H match lines: **2026 Washington (Hard)** - Final, WIN, 4-6, 6-4, 6-0 | [wtatennis.com]...
h2h_match_re = re.compile(
    r&#39;^(\s*-\s*\*\*\d{4}\s+([^*]+)\*\*\s*-\s*[^,]*,\s*(?:WIN|LOSS)[^,]*,\s*)(\d[\d\s,\-\(\)ret\.]*)(\s*\|\s*)(\[wtatennis\.com\]\([^)]+\))(.*)$&#39;
)
# Grand Slam Champions style: **2026 Rome - Clay Court - Loss** - [Match Stats](url)
gs_match_re = re.compile(
    r&#39;^(\s*-\s*\*\*(\d{4})\s+([^-]+)\s*-\s*[^-]+-\s*(?:Win|Loss|Win \(Retired\))\*\*\s*-\s*)(\[Match Stats\]\([^)]+\))(.*)$&#39;
)

new_lines = []

    if &#39;### Doubles&#39; in line and &#39;Best Performances&#39; in &#39;\n&#39;.join(lines[max(0,i-30):i]):
        in_doubles_best = True
    if line.startswith(&#39;### Singles&#39;) and &#39;Best Performances&#39; in section or (line.startswith(&#39;### Singles&#39;)):
        if &#39;Best Performances&#39; in &#39;\n&#39;.join(lines[max(0,i-20):i+1]) or section.startswith(&#39;## Best&#39;):
            in_doubles_best = False
    if line.startswith(&#39;## Matches Against&#39;):

        in_doubles_slam = False
    if line.startswith(&#39;### Doubles&#39;) and &#39;Grand Slam&#39; in section:

    if line.startswith(&#39;### Singles&#39;) and &#39;Grand Slam&#39; in section:

        current_tourney = tm.group(1).split(&#39;(&#39;)[0].strip()
        # strip &#34; - with Partner&#34;
        current_tourney = re.sub(r&#39;\s*-\s*with\s+.*$&#39;, &#39;&#39;, current_tourney, flags=re.I)

    ym = re.match(r&#39;^- (\d{4})$&#39;, line.strip()) or re.match(r&#39;^\s+- (\d{4})$&#39;, line)
    if line.strip() in (&#39;- 2026&#39;, &#39;- 2025&#39;, &#39;- 2024&#39;, &#39;- 2023&#39;, &#39;- 2022&#39;, &#39;- 2021&#39;):

    # skip if already has tennis-db.com

    if in_doubles_best or in_doubles_slam:

        score = m.group(3).strip()

                used_match_urls.add(hit[&#39;match&#39;])
                # insert after wtatennis link
                line = m.group(1) + m.group(3) + m.group(4) + m.group(5) + f&#39; | [tennis-db.com]({hit[&#34;match&#34;]})&#39; + m.group(6)
                match_links_added += 1
                inserted = True
            elif not hit:
                unmatched.append((&#39;h2h-style&#39;, opp, score, tourney_bit))

    if not inserted:
        m = gs_match_re.match(line)
        if m:
            year, tourney_bit = m.group(2), m.group(3).strip()
            opp = None
            for j in range(i, -1, -1):
                hm = re.match(r&#39;^### (.+)$&#39;, lines[j])
                if hm:

            if opp:

                unused = [c for c in cands if c[&#39;match&#39;] not in used_match_urls]
                hit = unused[0] if unused else (cands[0] if cands else None)
                if hit and hit[&#39;match&#39;] not in used_match_urls:
                    used_match_urls.add(hit[&#39;match&#39;])
                    line = m.group(1) + m.group(4) + f&#39; | [tennis-db.com]({hit[&#34;match&#34;]})&#39; + m.group(5)
                    match_links_added += 1

    if not inserted:

# --- normalize helpers ---
def norm_score(s):
    s = s.lower().replace(',', ' ')
    s = s.replace('(retired)', 'ret.').replace('ret.', 'ret')
    s = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', s)
    s = s.replace(' ', '')
    # 7-6(11) vs 7-6(11)
    return s

def norm_name(n):
    n = n.lower()
    # strip diacritics roughly
    trans = str.maketrans({
        'ć':'c','č':'c','š':'s','ž':'z','á':'a','é':'e','í':'i','ó':'o','ú':'u',
        'ñ':'n','ü':'u','ö':'o','ä':'a','ř':'r','ý':'y','ě':'e','ů':'u','î':'i',
        'â':'a','ê':'e','ô':'o','ą':'a','ę':'e','ł':'l','ń':'n','ś':'s','ź':'z','ż':'z',
        'ç':'c','ì':'i','ò':'o','ù':'u','ă':'a','ș':'s','ț':'t','ı':'i',
    })
    n = n.translate(trans)
    n = re.sub(r'[^a-z\s]', '', n)
    return re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', n).strip()

lines = text2.split('\n')
current_tourney = ''
current_year = ''
match_links_added = 0
ambiguous = 0
unmatched = []
used_match_urls = set()

def find_match(opp, score, tourney_ctx):
    opp_n = norm_name(opp)
    sc = norm_score(score)
    # try full name + score
    cands = by_opp_score.get((opp_n, sc), [])
    if not cands:
        # last name
        last = opp_n.split()[-1] if opp_n else ''
        cands = by_opp_score.get((last, sc), [])
    if not cands:
        return None, 'no-score-match'
    if len(cands) == 1:
        return cands[0], 'unique'
    # disambiguate by tournament
    tk = tourney_key(tourney_ctx)
    filtered = [c for c in cands if tk and tk in tourney_key(c['tournament'])]
    if len(filtered) == 1:
        return filtered[0], 'tourney'
    if len(filtered) > 1:
        # prefer unused
        unused = [c for c in filtered if c['match'] not in used_match_urls]
        if len(unused) == 1:
            return unused[0], 'unused'
        return unused[0] if unused else filtered[0], 'multi'
    # try year in date
    unused = [c for c in cands if c['match'] not in used_match_urls]
    if len(unused) == 1:
        return unused[0], 'unused-only'
    if tk:
        # fuzzy: any cand tournament contains a word from context
        words = set(tk.split())
        fuzzy = [c for c in cands if words & set(tourney_key(c['tournament']).split())]
        unusedf = [c for c in fuzzy if c['match'] not in used_match_urls]
        if len(unusedf) == 1:
            return unusedf[0], 'fuzzy'
    return (unused[0] if unused else cands[0]), 'fallback'

# Pattern for result lines with links
# Round, d./l. Opponent score | [wtatennis.com](...) | ...
result_re = re.compile(
    r'^(\s*.*?\b(?:d\.|l\.)\s+)(?:\[([^\]]+)\]\([^)]+\)|([A-Za-zÀ-ž][A-Za-zÀ-ž\s\-\']+?))(\s+)(\d[\d\s,\-\(\)ret\.w/o]*)(\s*\|\s*)(\[wtatennis\.com\]\([^)]+\))(.*)$'
)
# also lines that are only Round | [wtatennis.com] without d./l. - skip those for match matching unless we have round context
# H2H match lines: **2026 Washington (Hard)** - Final, WIN, 4-6, 6-4, 6-0 | [wtatennis.com]...
h2h_match_re = re.compile(
    r'^(\s*-\s*\*\*\d{4}\s+([^*]+)\*\*\s*-\s*[^,]*,\s*(?:WIN|LOSS)[^,]*,\s*)(\d[\d\s,\-\(\)ret\.]*)(\s*\|\s*)(\[wtatennis\.com\]\([^)]+\))(.*)$'
)
# Grand Slam Champions style: **2026 Rome - Clay Court - Loss** - [Match Stats](url)
gs_match_re = re.compile(
    r'^(\s*-\s*\*\*(\d{4})\s+([^-]+)\s*-\s*[^-]+-\s*(?:Win|Loss|Win \(Retired\))\*\*\s*-\s*)(\[Match Stats\]\([^)]+\))(.*)$'
)

new_lines = []
in_doubles_best = False
in_doubles_slam = False
section = ''

for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    if line.startswith('## '):
        section = line
    if '### Doubles' in line and 'Best Performances' in '\n'.join(lines[max(0,i-30):i]):
        in_doubles_best = True
    if line.startswith('### Singles') and 'Best Performances' in section or (line.startswith('### Singles')):
        if 'Best Performances' in '\n'.join(lines[max(0,i-20):i+1]) or section.startswith('## Best'):
            in_doubles_best = False
    if line.startswith('## Matches Against'):
        in_doubles_best = False
        in_doubles_slam = False
    if line.startswith('### Doubles') and 'Grand Slam' in section:
        in_doubles_slam = True
    if line.startswith('### Singles') and 'Grand Slam' in section:
        in_doubles_slam = False

    # track tournament headers
    tm = re.match(r'^\s+-\s+\*\*([^*]+)\*\*', line)
    if tm and not line.strip().startswith('- **20'):
        # e.g. **Washington (WTA 500, Hard)** or **Wimbledon**
        current_tourney = tm.group(1).split('(')[0].strip()
        # strip " - with Partner"
        current_tourney = re.sub(r'\s*-\s*with\s+.*$', '', current_tourney, flags=re.I)

    ym = re.match(r'^- (\d{4})$', line.strip()) or re.match(r'^\s+- (\d{4})$', line)
    if line.strip() in ('- 2026', '- 2025', '- 2024', '- 2023', '- 2022', '- 2021'):
        current_year = line.strip()[2:]

    # skip if already has tennis-db.com
    if 'tennis-db.com' in line:
        new_lines.append(line)
        continue

    # skip doubles sections for match links (no TennisDB doubles in log)
    if in_doubles_best or in_doubles_slam:
        new_lines.append(line)
        continue

    # skip walkovers for tennisdb? may exist - try match
    inserted = False

    # H2H Other Top 20 style with wtatennis
    m = h2h_match_re.match(line)
    if m:
        tourney_bit = m.group(2).strip()
        # extract opponent from nearby? hard - look at ### above
        # find last ### name
        opp = None
        for j in range(i, -1, -1):
            hm = re.match(r'^### (.+)$', lines[j])
            if hm:
                opp = hm.group(1)
                break
        score = m.group(3).strip()
        if opp:
            hit, how = find_match(opp, score, tourney_bit)
            if hit and hit['match'] not in used_match_urls:
                used_match_urls.add(hit['match'])
                # insert after wtatennis link
                line = m.group(1) + m.group(3) + m.group(4) + m.group(5) + f' | [tennis-db.com]({hit["match"]})' + m.group(6)
                match_links_added += 1
                inserted = True
            elif not hit:
                unmatched.append(('h2h-style', opp, score, tourney_bit))

    if not inserted:
        m = gs_match_re.match(line)
        if m:
            year, tourney_bit = m.group(2), m.group(3).strip()
            opp = None
            for j in range(i, -1, -1):
                hm = re.match(r'^### (.+)$', lines[j])
                if hm:
                    opp = hm.group(1)
                    break
            # no score on these lines - match by tourney+year+opp
            if opp:
                opp_n = norm_name(opp)
                tk = tourney_key(tourney_bit)
                cands = [c for c in by_opp.get(opp_n, by_opp.get(opp_n.split()[-1], []))
                         if year in c['date'] and tk in tourney_key(c['tournament'])]
                unused = [c for c in cands if c['match'] not in used_match_urls]
                hit = unused[0] if unused else (cands[0] if cands else None)
                if hit and hit['match'] not in used_match_urls:
                    used_match_urls.add(hit['match'])
                    line = m.group(1) + m.group(4) + f' | [tennis-db.com]({hit["match"]})' + m.group(5)
                    match_links_added += 1
                    inserted = True
                elif not hit:
                    unmatched.append(('gs-style', opp, year, tourney_bit))

    if not inserted:
        m = result_re.match(line)
        if m:
            opp = m.group(2) or m.group(3)
            opp = opp.strip()
            score = m.group(5).strip()
            # skip w/o if no tennisdb
            if score.endswith('w/o') or score == 'w/o':
                new_lines.append(line)
                continue
            hit, how = find_match(opp, score, current_tourney)
            if hit and hit['match'] not in used_match_urls:
                used_match_urls.add(hit['match'])
                # insert tennis-db after wtatennis
                rest = m.group(8)
                # avoid duplicating
                line = m.group(1) + (f'[{m.group(2)}](#{norm_name(m.group(2)).replace(" ","-")})' if m.group(2) else m.group(3)) 
                # WAIT - don't rebuild opponent link - keep original middle
                # Safer: replace only the wtatennis segment
                line_orig = lines[i]
                wta_link = m.group(7)
                line = line_orig.replace(wta_link, wta_link + f' | [tennis-db.com]({hit["match"]})', 1)
                match_links_added += 1
                inserted = True
            elif not hit:
                unmatched.append(('result', opp, score, current_tourney))

    new_lines.append(line)

text3 = '\n'.join(new_lines)
print('match links added:', match_links_added)
print('unmatched sample:', unmatched[:20], 'count', len(unmatched))
print('used urls', len(used_match_urls))

# bump lastmod
text3 = re.sub(r'^lastmod:.*$', 'lastmod: "2026-08-06T07:30:00Z"', text3, count=1, flags=re.M)

path.write_text(text3)
print('wrote', path)

def fold(s):
    s = unicodedata.normalize(&#39;NFKD&#39;, s)
    s = &#39;&#39;.join(c for c in s if not unicodedata.combining(c))
    return s.lower()

def norm_name(n):
    n = fold(n)
    n = re.sub(r&#39;[^a-z\s]&#39;, &#39;&#39;, n)
    return re.sub(r&#39;\s+&#39;, &#39; &#39;, n).strip()

def norm_score(s):
    s = fold(s)
    s = s.replace(&#39;,&#39;, &#39; &#39;)
    s = re.sub(r&#39;\s+&#39;, &#39;&#39;, s)
    s = s.replace(&#39;retired&#39;, &#39;ret&#39;).replace(&#39;ret.&#39;, &#39;ret&#39;)
    return s

def flip_score(s):
    # flip each set 6-4 -&gt; 4-6, keep tiebreak (5)
    parts = []
    for seg in re.split(r&#39;[,\s]+&#39;, s.strip()) if False else None:
        pass
    raw = re.findall(r&#39;(\d+)-(\d+)(?:\((\d+)\))?|(ret\.?)|(w/o)&#39;, s.replace(&#39;,&#39;, &#39; &#39;))
    # simpler split by comma
    out = []
    for piece in re.split(r&#39;,\s*&#39;, s.strip()):
        piece = piece.strip()
        if piece in (&#39;ret.&#39;, &#39;ret&#39;, &#39;w/o&#39;):
            out.append(piece.replace(&#39;.&#39;, &#39;&#39;))
            continue
        m = re.match(r&#39;(\d+)-(\d+)(?:\((\d+)\))?(?:\s*ret\.?)?$&#39;, piece)
        if not m:
            return None
        a,b,tb = m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3)
        bit = f&#39;{b}-{a}&#39; + (f&#39;({tb})&#39; if tb else &#39;&#39;)
        if piece.endswith(&#39;ret.&#39;) or piece.endswith(&#39;ret&#39;):
            bit += &#39;ret&#39;
        out.append(bit)
    return norm_score(&#39;,&#39;.join(out))

TOURNEY_ALIAS = {

    &#39;indian wells&#39;:&#39;indian wells&#39;,&#39;eastbourne&#39;:&#39;eastbourne&#39;,&#39;eastbourne open&#39;:&#39;eastbourne&#39;,
    &#39;nottingham&#39;:&#39;nottingham&#39;,&#39;bad homburg&#39;:&#39;bad homburg&#39;,&#39;stuttgart&#39;:&#39;stuttgart&#39;,&#39;linz&#39;:&#39;linz&#39;,
    &#39;strasbourg&#39;:&#39;strasbourg&#39;,&#39;hong kong&#39;:&#39;hong kong&#39;,&#39;guangzhou&#39;:&#39;guangzhou&#39;,&#39;sao paulo&#39;:&#39;sao paulo&#39;,
    &#39;guadalajara&#39;:&#39;guadalajara&#39;,&#39;wuhan&#39;:&#39;wuhan&#39;,&#39;ningbo&#39;:&#39;ningbo&#39;,&#39;osaka&#39;:&#39;osaka&#39;,
    &#39;jiujiang&#39;:&#39;jiujiang&#39;,&#39;monastir&#39;:&#39;monastir&#39;,&#39;hua hin&#39;:&#39;hua hin&#39;,&#39;singapore&#39;:&#39;singapore&#39;,
    &#39;doha&#39;:&#39;doha&#39;,&#39;manila&#39;:&#39;manila&#39;,&#39;jingshan&#39;:&#39;jingshan&#39;,&#39;canberra international&#39;:&#39;canberra&#39;,
    &#39;canberra&#39;:&#39;canberra&#39;,&#39;ilkley&#39;:&#39;ilkley&#39;,&#39;veneto open&#39;:&#39;veneto&#39;,&#39;cluj-napoca 1&#39;:&#39;cluj&#39;,
}

def tourney_key(t):
    t = norm_name(t)
    return TOURNEY_ALIAS.get(t, t)

matches = data[&#39;matches&#39;]
by_opp_score = {}
by_opp = {}
for m in matches:

    last = opp.split()[-1]

    by_opp.setdefault(last, []).append(m)

used = set(re.findall(r&#39;https://tennis-db\.com/wta/matches/[^)\s]+&#39;, text))

def find_match(opp, score, tourney_ctx, year_hint=None):
    opp_n = norm_name(opp)
    sc = norm_score(score)
    cands = by_opp_score.get((opp_n, sc), []) or by_opp_score.get((opp_n.split()[-1], sc), [])
    if not cands:

    if not cands:

        tk = tourney_key(tourney_ctx)

        cands = [c for c in pool if tk and tk in tourney_key(c[&#39;tournament&#39;])]
        if year_hint:
            cands = [c for c in cands if year_hint in c[&#39;date&#39;]]
    if not cands:
        return None
    if len(cands) == 1:
        return cands[0]
    tk = tourney_key(tourney_ctx)
    filtered = [c for c in cands if tk and tk in tourney_key(c[&#39;tournament&#39;])]
    if year_hint:
        filtered2 = [c for c in (filtered or cands) if year_hint in c[&#39;date&#39;]]
        if filtered2:
            filtered = filtered2
    pool = filtered or cands
    unused = [c for c in pool if c[&#39;match&#39;] not in used]
    return (unused or pool)[0]

def norm_score(s):
    s = fold(s)
    s = s.replace(',', ' ')
    s = re.sub(r'\s+', '', s)
    s = s.replace('retired', 'ret').replace('ret.', 'ret')
    return s

def flip_score(s):
    # flip each set 6-4 -> 4-6, keep tiebreak (5)
    parts = []
    for seg in re.split(r'[,\s]+', s.strip()) if False else None:
        pass
    raw = re.findall(r'(\d+)-(\d+)(?:\((\d+)\))?|(ret\.?)|(w/o)', s.replace(',', ' '))
    # simpler split by comma
    out = []
    for piece in re.split(r',\s*', s.strip()):
        piece = piece.strip()
        if piece in ('ret.', 'ret', 'w/o'):

            continue
        m = re.match(r'(\d+)-(\d+)(?:\((\d+)\))?(?:\s*ret\.?)?$', piece)

        a,b,tb = m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3)

        if piece.endswith('ret.') or piece.endswith('ret'):
            bit += 'ret'
        out.append(bit)

def fold(s):
    s = unicodedata.normalize('NFKD', s)

def norm_score(s):
    s = fold(s)

    s = s.replace('retired', 'ret').replace('ret.', 'ret')
    return s

def flip_score(s):
    out = []
    for piece in re.split(r',\s*', s.strip()):
        piece = piece.strip()
        if piece in ('ret.', 'ret', 'w/o'):

        m = re.match(r'(\d+)-(\d+)(?:\((\d+)\))?(?:\s*ret\.?)?$', piece)

        a, b, tb = m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3)
        bit = f'{b}-{a}' + (f'({tb})' if tb else '')
        if piece.endswith('ret.') or piece.endswith('ret'):
            bit += 'ret'
        out.append(bit)
    return norm_score(','.join(out))

def fold(s):
    s = unicodedata.normalize('NFKD', s)
    return ''.join(c for c in s if not unicodedata.combining(c)).lower()

def norm_name(n):
    n = fold(n)
    n = re.sub(r'[^a-z\s]', '', n)
    return re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', n).strip()

def norm_score(s):
    s = fold(s).replace(',', ' ')
    s = re.sub(r'\s+', '', s).replace('retired', 'ret').replace('ret.', 'ret')
    return s

def flip_score(s):
    out = []
    for piece in re.split(r',\s*', s.strip()):
        piece = piece.strip()
        if piece in ('ret.', 'ret', 'w/o'):
            out.append(piece.replace('.', '')); continue
        m = re.match(r'(\d+)-(\d+)(?:\((\d+)\))?(?:\s*ret\.?)?$', piece)
        if not m: return None
        a,b,tb = m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3)
        bit = f'{b}-{a}' + (f'({tb})' if tb else '')
        if piece.endswith(('ret.', 'ret')): bit += 'ret'
        out.append(bit)
    return norm_score(','.join(out))

}

def find_match(opp, score, tourney_ctx, year_hint=None):
    opp_n = norm_name(opp)

    cands = []

        cands = by_opp_score.get((opp_n, sc), []) or by_opp_score.get((last, sc), [])
        if not cands:
            # try without ret suffix on either side

        if not cands:
